reason: This plugin is primarily a planning-and-execution automation utility for DeepSeek Harness, because evidence shows it exposes invocable slash commands that guide a complete spec-driven development lifecycle (specify, plan, tasks, implementation, analysis, status) and ships as a plugin with registered skills.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 `/speckit-*` 斜杠命令提供规范驱动开发流程支持，覆盖需求定义、规划、任务拆解、实施与一致性检查。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides a spec-driven development workflow through `/speckit-*` slash commands, covering specification, planning, tasking, implementation, and consistency checks.

capabilities: Expose user-invokable `/speckit-*` commands for a spec-driven workflow
Create and update development artifacts such as specification, plan, task, checklist, and constitution files
Run consistency/check analysis on requirement, acceptance, and boundary coverage
Perform implementation actions from task definitions
Provide status/dashboard reporting for process progress and next steps
Support branch selection options for workflow execution

reasons.code: README documents a `/speckit-*` command suite including `/speckit-specify`, `/speckit-plan`, `/speckit-tasks`, `/speckit-implement`, `/speckit-analyze`, and `/speckit-status`, indicating direct workflow control features.
The plugin package structure and metadata include `lib/index.js` plus skill files under `skills/`, with DSH bundle wiring, confirming runtime command registration and executable command definitions.
Repository tree shows scripts and references used by commands (analysis scripts and spec kits references), matching the documented behavior of automated checks and process-driven operations.
